comment: Library artwork per game (prototype era, not final logos). 'lan:<slug>' is the title's own GameArt scene exported by the games repository (assets/vendor/lan-games-art/); 'kenney:<icon>' is a Kenney Board Game Icon (CC0, assets/vendor/kenney-board-game-icons/) used only where it genuinely depicts the game. tools/build-art.mjs writes web/party/art/<source>-<name>.svg; games without an entry show a generic icon. See docs/UI-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md.
